annotations.title: Best time to post on Instagram or TikTok

description: Best days and hours to post on Instagram or TikTok, in a chosen time zone. For Instagram it returns a starting schedule (three posting hours per day and the five strongest slots) for one of 10 niches, plus what large published studies found. For TikTok it returns what the published studies found, by day. Times are given for the audience's time zone, optionally shown in another one. A rule of thumb to test against your own analytics, not data from an account.

display_timezone.description: IANA time zone to show the times in. Default: the audience's time zone.

niche.description: Instagram only: the account's niche. Default general. Ignored for TikTok, whose studies are not split by niche.

timezone.description: IANA time zone where the audience lives, for example America/New_York or Asia/Kolkata. Default UTC.
